## Measure vs. price

Sandhi emits neutral **units** (tokens, cache split, GPU-seconds) and **never
dollars**. If your feature needs pricing, tiers, or SKU names, it belongs in the
downstream commercial layer (AnvaiOps), not here.

- [ ] This proposal stays on the neutral-units side of that boundary.
